subject: Invitation to our Annual Charity Gala
body: Dear valued supporters, We are excited to invite you to our Annual Charity Gala on October 15th at the Grand Ballroom. Join us for an evening of elegance and philanthropy, as we raise funds for local charities. The event will feature a gourmet dinner, live entertainment, and a silent auction. Your attendance and support will make a meaningful impact on those in need. RSVP by September 30th to secure your spot. We look forward to seeing you there! Sincerely, The Charity Foundation Team
